title: Board Schedule — Purchase Size Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Holding Ceiling, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The holding-ceiling size tolerance of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on what the member has put into the holding: purchases totalling 750000 or more give USD 5000; purchases totalling 250000 or more but below 750000 give USD 2500; smaller totals give none.

## Schedule

| Total of all purchases on the holding | Holding-ceiling size tolerance |
|---|---|
| 750000 or more | USD 5000 |
| 250000 or more but below 750000 | USD 2500 |
| Below 250000 | None |

The total is the sum of every purchase entry on the holding; reinvested dividends and retirements do not enter it. The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the holding ceiling before the excess over the ceiling is taken.

## Edges (hypothetical purchase totals)

| Purchases totalling | Tolerance |
|---|---|
| 749,999.99 | USD 2500 |
| 750,000.00 | USD 5000 |
| 250,000.00 | USD 2500 |
| 249,999.99 | None |
